run_main_fasttext: run the main_fasttext CLI to find nearest-neighbor pseudoalignments between SQuAD and HotpotQA questions
run_decomp: run the decomp function to compute beam search pseudoalignments between easy and hard question sets
run_dump_pseudoalignments: run dump_pseudoalignments to save pseudoalignment results to a data folder
run_load_nlp: run load_nlp to load spaCy NLP model for tokenizing and vectorizing questions
run_faiss_index: run faiss IndexFlatIP indexing on L2-normalized question vectors for fast cosine similarity search
